negativeControl.description: Every case is replayed with an assistant-only transcript containing no MCP calls.

positiveControl.description: The preserved nine-case historical result contains complete passed objective criteria and clean teardown.
positiveControl.limitation: The historical raw traces are local and are not regraded; this control validates the retained result contract, not current-model qualification.

interReviewerAgreement.reason: All release-gating verifiers are deterministic engine, state, policy, trace, or cleanup checks; no human or LLM categorical grades are aggregated.

releaseInterpretation: The audit qualifies scorer wiring and deterministic controls. It does not substitute for an authorized paired stochastic model run.
